source.document_reference: APQC PCF Cross-Industry v8.0 (Feb 2026), process anchor pending verification (accounts payable payment processing); step decomposition per docs/HELDOUT_SPEC_2026-10-10.md (signed off 10 Oct 2026). APQC activity IDs pending verification against PCF v8.0 text.

steps.name: Due-item selection
steps.description: Approved, matched invoices falling due under their payment terms are selected for the payment run, including foreign-currency items.

steps.name: Payment proposal generation
steps.description: The ERP generates a payment proposal from the due-item list, grouping items by vendor, currency and payment method.

steps.name: Proposal review
steps.description: The proposal is reviewed for duplicate payments, blocked vendors and recent changes to vendor bank details, and exceptions are removed or held.

steps.name: Payment approval
steps.description: The reviewed proposal is approved for payment by an authorised signatory within delegated limits.

steps.name: Payment file generation and release to bank
steps.description: The approved proposal is converted into a bank payment file and released to the bank.

steps.name: Bank confirmation receipt
steps.description: The bank's confirmation of executed payments is received and matched to the transmitted file.

steps.name: Posting and clearing
steps.description: Settled payments are posted, clearing open items in the AP subledger and recording cash in the GL, with foreign-currency settlement differences recognised.

steps.name: Remittance advice to vendors
steps.description: Vendors are sent remittance advice detailing the invoices settled by each payment.

requirements.statement: Whatever carries due-item selection must still consume approved matched invoices.
Proposal review, which includes the duplicate-payment check, must occur before payment approval.
Proposal review, which verifies vendor bank-detail changes, must occur before the payment file is released to the bank.
Payment proposal and payment approval must not be performed by the same actor.
Payment approval must occur before the payment file is generated and released to the bank.
Whatever carries posting and clearing must still consume the bank settlement confirmation (KB-11).
Whatever carries posting and clearing must still consume the settlement-date exchange rate (KB-08).
Payment proposal generation must survive in some form.
Proposal review must survive in some form.
Payment approval must survive in some form.
Payment file generation and release must survive in some form.
